name: Shelf
summary: Holds files, links and text you drop on the notch, and new screenshots, until you drag them out again.
trigger: Dragging something toward the notch, or taking a screenshot

settings.title: Show the item count beside the notch
Off: the notch looks untouched while the shelf holds items; move the pointer onto it to open the shelf. On: a small count sits in the menu bar, left of the notch.
Add new screenshots to the shelf
The screenshot stays in the folder macOS saves it to. The shelf holds it so you can drag it from the notch to where it belongs.
